verdict.rationale: telli's docs say built-in tracking covers reach rate, call duration and success rate. They also describe analysis of individual calls, transcripts and call outcome fields, a Live Monitoring real-time call overview, and call analysis through the Charlie assistant, so the core analytics come without building your own. Missing for 10: any evidence of sentiment analytics, detail on the dashboard views themselves (charts, breakdowns, exports), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond brief vendor doc snippets.
